content: कूट {%a.%} .²1 False; as in कूटाः स्युः पूर्वसाक्षिणः <ls>Y. 2. 80</ls>; दुस्तोषः कूटयोगिनाम् <ls>Bhāg. 2. 9. 19</ls>. .²2 Immovable, steady. .²3 Despised. .{@-टः, -टम्@} .²1 Fraud, illusion, deception. .²2 A trick, fraudulent or roguish scheme; अक्षकूटमधिष्ठाय हृतं दुर्योधनेन वै <ls>Mb. 3. 33. 3</ls>. .²3 A puzzling question, knotty or intricate point, as in कूटश्लोक, कूटान्योक्ति; वाचः कूटं तु देवर्षेः स्वयं विममृशुर्धिया <ls>Bhāg. 6. 5. 10</ls>. .²4 Falsehood, untruth; <ab>oft.</ab> used in <ab>comp.</ab> with the force of an adjective; ˚वचनम् false or deceitful words; ˚तुला, ˚मानम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 A summit or peak of a mountain; वर्धयन्निव तत्कूटानुद्धतैर्धातुरेणुभिः <ls>R. 4. 71</ls>; <ls>Me. 115</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 32</ls>. .²6 Any projection or prominence. .²7 The bone of the forehead with its projections, the crown of the head. .²8 A horn; सम्परेतमयःकूटैश्छिन्दन्त्युत्थितमन्यवः <ls>Bhāg. 4. 25. 8</ls>. .²9 End, corner; <ls>Y. 3. 96</ls>. .²10 Head, chief. .²11 A heap, mass, multitude; अभ्रकूटम् ‘a heap of clouds’; so अन्नकूटम् ‘a heap of food’; <ls>Mv. 6. 32</ls>. .²12 A hammer, an iron mallet. .²13 A plough-share, the body of a plough. .²14 A trap for catching deer; नश्येदभिमृशन्सद्यो मृगः कूटमिव स्पृशन् <ls>Mb. 12. 68. 52</ls>. .²15 A concealed weapon, as a dagger in a woollen case or a sword in a stick. .²16 A water-jar. .²17 The door of a city; निर्ययुर्भवनात्तस्मात्कूटमुद्गरपाणयः <ls>Rām. 5. 42. 25</ls>. .²18 A false coin; कूटं हि निषादानामेवोपकारकं न आर्याणाम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 1. 52</ls>. .{@-टः@} .²1 A house, dwelling. .²2 An ox whose horns are broken. .²3 An epithet of Agastya.
